mapper.sql:
(SELECT d.textbook_edition_id FROM product_textbook_details d WHERE d.product_id = p.id) AS tb_edition_id, (SELECT json_build_object( 'editionId', d.textbook_edition_id, 'isbn', d.isbn_snapshot, 'title', d.title_snapshot, 'editionLabel', d.edition_snapshot, 'publisher', d.publisher_snapshot, 'courseNames', COALESCE(( SELECT json_agg(x.name ORDER BY x.name COLLATE "C") FROM (SELECT DISTINCT c.name FROM course_textbooks ct JOIN course_offerings o ON o.id = ct.course_offering_id AND o.active JOIN courses c ON c.id = o.course_id AND c.active WHERE ct.textbook_edition_id = d.textbook_edition_id AND ct.verification_status = 'VERIFIED') x), '[]'::json))::text FROM product_textbook_details d WHERE d.product_id = p.id) AS tb_json,
CASE WHEN p.listing_kind = 'BUNDLE' THEN ( SELECT json_build_object('itemCount', count(*), 'totalQuantity', sum(bi.quantity), 'categoryCount', count(DISTINCT bi.category))::text FROM bundle_items bi WHERE bi.product_id = p.id) END AS bundle_json

CASE WHEN p.visibility = 'CIRCLE_ONLY' THEN ( SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('id', c.id, 'name', c.name, 'type', c.type) ORDER BY c.name COLLATE "C", c.id)::text FROM product_circle_visibility v JOIN circles c ON c.id = v.circle_id AND c.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE v.product_id = p.id AND (p.seller_id = #{uid,javaType=java.util.UUID,jdbcType=OTHER} OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM circle_memberships m WHERE m.circle_id = v.circle_id AND m.status = 'ACTIVE' AND m.user_id = #{uid,javaType=java.util.UUID,jdbcType=OTHER}))) END AS circle_json
